description: This file contains internal implementation classes for fault injection testing within the Orleans Transaction framework, including a TransactionManager and transactional resource classes that handle fault injection points, logging, and deactivation logic.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionManager
classes.description: Manages fault-injected transaction operations, including PrepareAndCommit, Prepared, and Ping, with the ability to inject faults and trigger deactivation.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalResource
classes.description: Represents a transactional resource with fault injection points, handling commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations, with fault injection and deactivation logic.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction, with fault injection at specific phases, and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Marks a transaction as prepared, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Pings a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Commits a read-only transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a transaction with fault injection, possibly injecting faults before or after store operations.
